releaseNotes:
- Add optional Randomize retry interval to Ticketek, Ticketmaster and Marketplace Auto Clicker, plus Marketplace Monitoring's separate click interval. Off by default; variation defaults to ±100 ms. For example, 500 ms gives a fresh 400–600 ms delay per retry, within platform limits.
- Remember interval variation locally and pass it through Start, F9/F10, extension shortcuts and saved monitoring operations. Keep exact interval entry and 50 ms slider steps.
- Disable randomization in Turbo/Instant mode. Keep response waits, selection/held-ticket/Stop safeguards and refresh/search/recovery timers unchanged. Browser scheduling can make actual clicks slower than the selected delay.
- Add policy, popup and browser-fixture tests for randomized pacing, saved options, mode disabling, sequential Marketplace attempts and existing Ticketek/Ticketmaster retry flows. Live site and native Firefox validation remain required.
